title: Banking Mainframe Transformation
subtitle: DB2 + COBOL + CICS → AWS
description: Core banking runs on IBM z/OS with COBOL and CICS transactions over DB2 for z/OS and VSAM files, batch driven by JCL. We want to modernize onto AWS incrementally, keep the mainframe running during coexistence, and meet strict regulatory and DR requirements.
